# GEOX — Earth Intelligence Organ of the arifOS Federation

> GEOX is the Earth Intelligence organ of the arifOS Federation: a governed MCP
> service for geological, geophysical, hazard, terrain, mobility and
> infrastructure reasoning. Every surface is dual-authored — rendered for
> humans, enumerated for agents. Creed: DITEMPA BUKAN DIBERI — "truth must cool
> before it rules." Humility band Ω₀ ≈ 0.04.

## Endpoints

- MCP endpoint (SSE transport): https://geox.arif-fazil.com/mcp
- Health: https://geox.arif-fazil.com/health
- Agent profile: https://geox.arif-fazil.com/profile
- Scenarios: https://geox.arif-fazil.com/scenarios
- WebMCP manifest: https://geox.arif-fazil.com/.well-known/mcp.json

## Capabilities

- 31 governed MCP tools (geox.* namespace): basin screening, STOIIP/volumetrics,
  seismic attribute review, flood-risk triage, route viability, infrastructure
  watch, hazard escalation, risk matrix, verdict console, VAULT999 sealing.
- 20 MCP App widgets (SEP-1865 GUI, active with live bindings): WellDesk,
  Seismic Vision, Earth Volume, Risk Console, Judge Console, Basin Explorer,
  Prospect Studio, Geoprobe, GravMag Studio, and more. (8 additional Apps
  held as 'planned' awaiting F13 resurrection of ghosted tools; 3 deprecated.)
- A2A negotiation via AAA control plane (:3001).

## Epistemic Contract (E1–E5)

- E1 Every response includes `epistemic_layer: OBS | DER | INT | SPEC`.
- E2 SPEC outputs are capped by RASA ≤ 0.90 and labeled hypothesis.
- E3 Irreversible/high-risk calls return `status: 888_HOLD` until sovereign human release (F13).
- E4 Agents may seal any result to VAULT999 via `geox.seal_vault999()`.
- E5 Ω₀ ≈ 0.04 — the Earth keeps its humility band; your model should too.

## Governance

Constitutional floors F1–F13 of the arifOS Federation apply to every call.
F13 — Sovereign Human Veto (888_HOLD) — is load-bearing: a human can always
stop the machine. Federation organs: arifOS :8088, A-FORGE :7071/:7072,
AAA :3001, GEOX :8081, WEALTH :18082, WELL :18083, HERMES :8644.

## Quickstart (60 seconds)

1. Point your MCP client at `https://geox.arif-fazil.com/mcp` (SSE).
2. Call a tool, e.g. `geox.stoiip({ prospect: "KINABALU-N", p50_area_km2: 42 })`.
3. Render an app, e.g. register `geox.app.welldesk` as an SEP-1865 inline widget.
